subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy while preserving boolean compatibility, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent `config.patch`?
rationale: The remaining fix changes Feishu's public config surface and touches the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, which is a product and security-default choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Adopt shared preview policy
options.body: Add Feishu support for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, preserve boolean compatibility, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Fix wording only
options.body: Reduce misleading exec status copy without adding a Feishu hide-progress control, leaving the main streaming-interruption complaint only partly addressed.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit agent-side mutation of `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens the protected config boundary and still disables all streaming instead of just progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared preview policy
recommendation.body: Add Feishu support for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, preserve boolean compatibility, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Feishu streaming-card config and runtime path introduced by PR #10379.
